What are the three most important things you would tell a UCPH student who is going to your host institution on exchange? *
questions.answer:
Go out to explore as much as possible before the semester starts and after the semester ends, as you might be too tired in the semester. 
Befriend your dorm mates and classmates, invite them out and try to eat with them as much as possible. 
Convenience store food is actually pretty expensive in the long run, going to chain restaurants is a better bang for your buck.
